name: Zimmer Biomet
description: Zimmer Biomet makes knee and hip replacements, sports medicine, extremities, trauma, dental, spine and surgical-robotics products, sold to hospitals and surgery centres through a sales force that is shifting from independent agents to employees. Revenue comes per surgery: an implant set plus instruments, with robots as capital that pull through implant sales. Reporting is by three regional segments (Americas, EMEA, Asia Pacific), not by product, so product-line profit is not disclosed. Knees and hips together are 66 percent of sales.

sub.name: Surgical and hospital devices and diagnostics

employees.note: about 7,000 in the US and 10,000 outside; about 6,000 in manufacturing, 2,000 in R&D

businessLines.name: Americas
businessLines.how: Implant and instrument sales to US hospitals and surgery centres via a mixed employee and independent-agent sales force; the US is about 95 percent of the region.

businessLines.name: EMEA
businessLines.how: Implant and instrument sales to hospitals across Europe, the Middle East and Africa, partly via distributors.

businessLines.name: Asia Pacific
businessLines.how: Implant and instrument sales to hospitals in Japan, China, Australia and elsewhere in Asia Pacific.

businessLines.name: Product category view: Knees
businessLines.how: Per-surgery sale of knee implant sets and instruments; robot capital supports pull-through.

businessLines.name: Product category view: Hips
businessLines.how: Per-surgery sale of hip implants and instruments.

businessLines.name: Product category view: S.E.T. (Sports Medicine, Extremities, Trauma)
businessLines.how: Per-surgery sale of shoulder, foot and ankle, sports-medicine and trauma implants; up 15.2 percent in 2025 with the Paragon 28 acquisition.

businessLines.name: Product category view: Technology & Data, Bone Cement and Surgical
businessLines.how: Robotics and data software, bone cement and surgical consumables, sold to hospitals alongside implants.

brands.name: Paragon 28, Inc.
brands.note: acquired 2025-04-21; added 2.5 percent to 2025 sales growth; lower operating margin than the rest of the company
